common.tagline: Your metadata. Your catalogs. Your way.
donate.title: Support MetaLayer
donate.body: MetaLayer is built and maintained as an independent project. Donations help cover hosting, tooling, and continued development.

overview.body: Combine providers, catalogs, and rules into one MetaLayer configuration for Stremio.
overview.nextStepsBody: Connect sources, set language and region, then shape catalogs before installing.
overview.modeSimpleBody: Simple mode shows the essential modules. Switch to Advanced for sorting, tracking, corrections, and more.
overview.modeAdvancedBody: Advanced mode exposes field-level controls, tracking, corrections, and diagnostics.
overview.importHint: Legacy TMDB Addon import will create a native MetaLayer configuration without changing your old URL.
